name: IC Microcontroller — USB, CAN, 3.6V — QFN
description: Surface-mount microcontroller IC cluster featuring USB, CAN, and 3.6V facets in QFN package footprints.
selection_hints: Select between QFN-64 (9x9mm, 0.5mm pitch) and WQFN-28 (4x4mm, 0.4mm pitch) footprints.
Prefer Tier A parts like PIC32MX575F256H or PIC32MX575F512H over Tier B parts.
Choose based on required footprint size and pin count.
avoid_when: Through-hole or non-SMD mounting is required.
Package types other than QFN or WQFN are required.
The application requires microcontrollers without USB, CAN, or 3.6V specs.
